title: HOW WE GREW & Our Milestones
sub: From our first live press in Sutton to multi-event catering, official 5-star certification, and nationwide franchise expansion.

items.title: The First Fresh Press
items.desc: Opened our signature fresh cold-pressed sugarcane juice stall in Sutton, bringing raw, 100% natural cane juice to London.

items.title: Official 5★ Certification
items.desc: Earned our official 5-Star Food Hygiene rating and full compliance registration with Sutton Council & NCASS.

items.title: Live Event Cane Bars
items.desc: Launched mobile live-pressing setups for weddings, birthdays, corporate popups, and large multicultural festivals.

items.title: Community Love & Regulars
items.desc: Crossed thousands of happy customers with a 4.9★ community satisfaction score and loyal repeat juice lovers.

items.title: Franchise Expansion
items.desc: Rolled out turnkey franchise partnership packages and wholesale supply across London and the UK.
